hidden_commitment_requirements.meaning: The account object must not reveal link(w) or link(r), otherwise the sampler is conditioned on public link rows and the support floor falls below target.
A successful opening must determine the committed link values well enough to apply bounded-kernel soundness, or produce a named binding break.
The link equation proof cannot be a public projection of the sigma equation; that shortcut is already known to add no security.
The verifier needs evidence for link(z) = link(r) + c * link(w) without learning the hidden link values.
The hidden representative sampler may condition on the semantic quotient, canonical packing, fiber-state equality, and bounds, but not on revealed link rows or active pads.

fields: hiding : commitment view does not condition the representative sampler on L
binding_or_break : two openings of one commitment imply equal link value or BindingBreak
link_equation_proof : accepts proof of committed link(z) = committed link(r) + c * committed link(w)
non_public_projection : link equation acceptance is not implied by the public sigma equation alone
bounded_kernel : ker(semantic) cap ker(link) cap responseBox = {0} or LinkKernelBreak
lean_facing_shape.target_theorem: accepted + hidden_committed_link + no binding/link/projection/hiding breaks -> account-backed quotient witness
